description: Defines the ExpressionInfo class used to describe expressions in Apache Spark SQL Catalyst module, including metadata and validation logic.

classes.name: ExpressionInfo
classes.description: Class representing metadata and descriptive information for Spark SQL expressions, including validation and formatting logic.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the expression.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns the usage string with function name replacements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the expression.

methods.name: getExtended
methods.description: Returns the extended description with function name replacements.

methods.name: getSince
methods.description: Returns the version since the expression is available.

methods.name: getExamples
methods.description: Returns the examples with function name replacements.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the expression.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group category of the expression.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Returns the database name if specified.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source of the expression.

methods.name: replaceFunctionName
methods.description: Replaces placeholder _FUNC_ with the expression name in usage strings.
